title: Mayer–Vietoris diagram for localized graded cohomology
statement:
Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], let $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For an open subscheme $W\subseteq Y$ and $n\ge0$ let $\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n}$ be the tensor power of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and for $n<0$ put $\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n}=(\mathcal L|_W^{\vee})^{\otimes(-n)}$ with $\mathcal L^{\vee}$ the dual of [def-sc-invertible-module]. For $p\ge0$ set $H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbb Z}H^p(W,\mathcal F|_W\otimes\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n})$ [pqf-def-cohomology], a graded module over $\Gamma_*(Y,\mathcal L)=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ via restriction, tensor product and multiplication of sections, and let $H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}$ be the degree-zero part of its localization at the homogeneous element $s$ of degree $1$. Let $W_s=W\cap Y_s$, with $Y_s$ the open subscheme where $s$ does not vanish [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and let $c^p_W:H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\to H^p(W_s,\mathcal F|_{W_s})$ be the canonical map sending $\xi/s^n$ to $s^{-n}\xi$. Let $U\subseteq Y$ be a quasi-compact open and $V\subseteq Y$ an affine open. Then $U_s\cap V_s=(U\cap V)_s$ and $U_s\cup V_s=(U\cup V)_s$, and there is a commutative diagram with exact rows
$$
\begin{array}{ccccccc}
\cdots\to H^{p-1}_*(U\cap V,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}&\to&H^p_*(U\cup V,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}&\to&H^p_*(U,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\oplus H^p_*(V,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}&\to&H^p_*(U\cap V,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\to\cdots\\
\downarrow{\scriptstyle c^{p-1}_{U\cap V}}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle c^p_{U\cup V}}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle c^p_U\oplus c^p_V}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle c^p_{U\cap V}}\\
\cdots\to H^{p-1}(U_s\cap V_s,\mathcal F)&\to&H^p(U_s\cup V_s,\mathcal F)&\to&H^p(U_s,\mathcal F)\oplus H^p(V_s,\mathcal F)&\to&H^p(U_s\cap V_s,\mathcal F)\to\cdots
\end{array}
$$
for all $p\ge0$ (with $H^{-1}=0$), in which the lower row is the Mayer--Vietoris long exact sequence of $\mathcal F|_{(U\cup V)_s}$ for the open cover $(U\cup V)_s=U_s\cup V_s$, and the upper row is the degree-zero part of the localization at $s$ of the direct sum over $n\in\mathbb Z$ of the Mayer--Vietoris long exact sequences of $\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n}$ for the open cover of $U\cup V$ by $U$ and $V$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 09MR (coherent-lemma-invert-s-cohomology), proof, Mayer–Vietoris paragraph; Tags 01EB and 05QB

proof.text: For each integer n, apply the Mayer–Vietoris open-cover node to the quasi-coherent module F|_{U\cup V}\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n} and the cover U\cup V=U\cup V. Taking the direct sum over n gives a long exact sequence of the graded groups H^p_*(-,\mathcal L,\mathcal F) with degree-preserving maps. The maps are \Gamma_*(Y,\mathcal L)-linear: multiplication by t\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L^{\otimes m}) is induced by the module map \mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n}\to\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes(n+m)}, x\mapsto x\otimes t, and the node's naturality in F says that the Mayer–Vietoris maps, connecting maps included, commute with it. The principal-open identities U_s\cap V_s=(U\cap V)_s and U_s\cup V_s=(U\cup V)_s are immediate since W_s=W\cap Y_s.

proof.text: The sequence of step 1 is an exact sequence of graded \Gamma_*(Y,\mathcal L)-modules with degree-preserving maps, and s is homogeneous of degree 1. By the graded-localization exactness node (its last sentence, applied to this infinite exact sequence) it stays exact after localizing at s and taking the degree-zero part. Thus the upper row in the statement is exact.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 09MR proof, Mayer–Vietoris paragraph

proof.text: Apply the Mayer–Vietoris open-cover node to F|_{(U\cup V)_s} and the cover (U\cup V)_s=U_s\cup V_s, with U_s\cap V_s=(U\cap V)_s (step 1): this is the lower exact row. Commutativity of the squares: for W\in\{U,V,U\cap V,U\cup V\} and \xi\in H^p(W,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n}), c^p_W(\xi/s^n) is the restriction of \xi to W_s followed by the map induced by the isomorphism \mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n}|_{W_s}\to\mathcal F|_{W_s}, x\mapsto s^{-n}x. The restriction maps form a morphism of Mayer–Vietoris sequences (naturality of the node under the inclusion of the cover (U\cup V)_s=U_s\cup V_s into U\cup V=U\cup V, with (U\cup V)_s\cap U=U_s and so on), and the isomorphism induces a morphism of Mayer–Vietoris sequences on (U\cup V)_s (naturality of the node in F; the connecting maps of the derived-functor long exact sequences commute with morphisms of short exact sequences [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor], [pqf-def-cohomology]). Composing, each square commutes on every element \xi/s^n; hence the maps c^p_W form the displayed morphism of exact long sequences.
